title: 3dClusterize
description: A tool for voxelwise thresholding and clusterizing of datasets.

inset.description: Load in a dataset for thresholding and clusterizing
inset.title: Input dataset

mask.description: Load in a dataset to use as a mask
mask.title: Mask dataset

mask_from_hdr.description: Use internal mask from dataset header
mask_from_hdr.title: Mask from header flag

out_mask.description: Specify to dump the utilized mask as a dataset
out_mask.title: Output mask name

ithr.description: Specify the sub-brick to use as the threshold source
ithr.title: Threshold sub-brick

idat.description: Specify the sub-brick to use as the data source
idat.title: Data sub-brick

within_range.description: Keep values within the range [AA, BB]
within_range.title: Within range values

nn.description: Specify the number of voxel neighbors (1: 6, 2: 18, 3: 26)
nn.title: Number of neighbors

clust_nvox.description: Specify the minimum cluster size in terms of number of voxels
clust_nvox.title: Minimum cluster size by voxels

clust_vol.description: Specify the minimum cluster size by volume in microliters
clust_vol.title: Minimum cluster size by volume

pref_map.description: Prefix/filename of the output map of cluster ROIs
pref_map.title: Output map prefix

pref_dat.description: Output a cluster-masked version of the data volume
pref_dat.title: Output cluster-masked data

no_one_d_format.description: Do not write output in 1D format
no_one_d_format.title: No 1D format output

summarize.description: Write out only the total nonzero voxel count and volume for each dataset
summarize.title: Summarize output

outvol_if_no_clust.description: Output an empty volume if no clusters are found
outvol_if_no_clust.title: Output volume if no clusters

orient.description: Coordinate order in the output report table (default: RAI)
orient.title: Output orientation

abs_table_data.description: Use absolute values for mean and SEM in report table
abs_table_data.title: Absolute table data

binary.description: Turn output map of cluster ROIs into a binary mask
binary.title: Binary output
